scope: Selected transcript interpretation, not clinical validation or a complete synthesis of all 720 sources.

rules.title: Kettlebell Snatch Nerd math video 1 - volume cycle
rules.quote: four sets of five on each side inside of a minute every minute on the minute
rules.supported_scope: Snatch-specific example: 4 to 20 EMOM sets, five per side; one- or two-set increments are discussed.

rules.title: Kettlebell Snatch Nerd Math part 2 - density cycle
rules.quote: 16 and we multiply it by 6 and that gives us 96 reps on each side
rules.supported_scope: Snatch-only density example: 16×6, 14×7, 12×8, 11×9, 10×10 per side, still EMOM.

rules.title: Kettlebell Double Clean and Press / Double Front Squat Nerd Math Part 2
rules.quote: three sets of five to ten sets of five three sets of four to ten sets of four three sets of three to ten sets of three
rules.supported_scope: Double clean/press and front squat worked examples: 3–10 sets of 3, 4 or 5; three-minute rounds discussed.

rules.title: Clean and Press and Double Front Squat - some very nerdy trainer nerd math and program design
rules.quote: you obviously need pairs of kettlebells
rules.supported_scope: Matched-pair assumption and fixed-weight volume programming; two- or three-minute rounds are discussed.
app_defaults_not_claimed_as_source_rules: no maximum testing in the app

rules.title: Heavy / light training nerd math ideas to improve your program success with kettlebell training
rules.quote: your heavy day should have a lower overall work capacity than your light day
rules.supported_scope: Heavier exposures have less total work than the completed lighter exposure. Whole-set rounding matters.

rules.title: Kettlebell Program Design 2 - Heavy/Light
rules.quote: on your light day you do high volume and on your heavy day you pick another weight of kettlebell
rules.supported_scope: Vary heavy/light demand for sustainable long-term practice; not a maximum-effort prescription.

rules.title: 2 Hand Heavy Club - Order of operation - strategy for training
rules.quote: for the most part we do time under tension for anything under 50 pounds with the two-handed club
rules.supported_scope: Two-hand club strategy emphasizes light-to-heavy, simple-to-complex timed practice. It does not specify this app’s isolated cast/circle bout lengths.

rules.title: Kettlebell -the order of operation of learning
rules.quote: we have to go back and shore up a weakness
rules.supported_scope: Foundational skill before complexity and heavy loading; the precise skill checklist is an app safeguard.

rules.title: How to adjust when you are unable to progress beyond certain numbers in a program - Nerd Math
rules.quote: we can change the number of reps and match the volume
rules.supported_scope: Adjust sets/reps rather than repeat failed work; examples use roughly 60% or 80% reps and redistributed work.

rules.title: Program Design 4 - Basic Kettlebell, 2 Hand Heavy Club, Single arm Club - Training Tetris
rules.quote: because both of these things will be covered very intensively in the two-handed Club program
rules.supported_scope: Consider movement overlap and recoverability when combining implements. The app does not reproduce the complete club program described.

rules.title: Recovering from injury or from potential injury -  Nerd Math series
rules.quote: my rebuild strategy is going to be different from your rebuild strategy
rules.supported_scope: A personal injury/recovery narrative supports adapting familiar work. Its personal percentages are not prescribed automatically.

rules.title: Kettlebell Turkish Getup Nerd Math Goal 1 - Time Under Tension overview
rules.quote: three minutes four minutes five minutes six minutes seven minutes eight minutes nine minutes to get to our goal of 10 minutes
rules.supported_scope: Alternating familiar single get-ups, building 3–10 total minutes under load, with optional 30-second intermediate steps.

rules.title: Turkish Getup Nerd Math video 2
rules.quote: you can repeat with every weight you have
rules.supported_scope: The 10-minute goal can be repeated at another weight. Advanced same-side multi-rep sets are a different, unimplemented pathway.

rules.title: Single Arm Heavy Club / Steel Club - order of operation - general training overview
rules.quote: people will start with four sets of five or maybe five sets of five
rules.supported_scope: Single-arm inside/outside/shield foundations use continuous volume at fixed reps, building toward 20×5 per side; not kettlebell EMOM rest.

rules.title: Single arm Heavy Club / steel club - order of operation - video 2
rules.quote: two minute break is kind of a good in between
rules.supported_scope: Rest between exercises, not between sets of a movement; two minutes is one discussed example.

rules.title: Practical Shoulder Therapy Through Strength of Movement - Single Arm Heavy Club Shield Cast 7
rules.quote: when you've gone up through at least three weights and done a logical two-handed program for one to two years
rules.supported_scope: Single-arm shield casting follows a substantial two-hand foundation and progressive support removal; not an immediate beginner substitution.
app_defaults_not_claimed_as_source_rules: self-confirmation of previous foundation rather than automatic logged-year certification
